description: Docstrings and explanatory comments still appear in code, and nothing checks them against the code, so they drift out of date. Add a diff-scoped gate that fails when a pull request adds a docstring or a non-allowlisted comment, and tell the agent prompts the invariant.
goal: Enforce this maintainer invariant (2026-11-27) for lines added by a change only: Code is self-explaining: names state the intent of every statement; a block that cannot be named where it is gets extracted into a function whose name says what it does. No docstrings and no explanatory comments in any language (Python, shell, Makefile, Dockerfile, YAML, JS). The only allowed comment is a `# why:` comment that records a reason the code cannot show (a constraint, an incident, a non-obvious decision), never what the code does. Machine directives are not comments in this sense and stay allowed: shebangs, encoding lines, `# noqa`, `# type:`, `# pragma`, `# fmt:`, shellcheck directives. Deliver: (1) a new scripts/check_self_explaining.py that inspects only the lines added relative to the merge base with origin/main (or relative to HEAD with --staged) and fails on any added module, class or function docstring (Python, via ast), any added '#' comment in Python (via tokenize, so '#' inside string literals is not a comment), shell, Makefile, Dockerfile, YAML and TOML files, and any added '//' or JSDoc comment in JavaScript; a '# why:' comment and the machine directives above pass. The check is wired into the lint task in pyproject.toml, into the staged-files mode of scripts/pre_commit_check.py, and into a named step of .github/workflows/test-hygiene.yml. Tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_check_self_explaining.py cover module, class and function docstrings, '#' comments, '# why:' allowed, machine directives allowed, shell, YAML and Makefile '#' comments, and unchanged lines never flagged. (2) The four agent prompt templates holon-config/prompts/planner.template.md, executor.template.md, review_loop.template.md and conflict_resolver.template.md state the invariant; the review loop template tells reviewers to report any violation as an Important finding; apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_prompt_templates.py asserts the invariant phrases. Existing docstrings and comments are not removed by this change. Module line budgets (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) are frozen: do not edit that file or any budget-check script, and keep every touched module within its current budget, splitting logic into new small modules where needed.
rationale: Prose in docstrings and comments drifts from the code, and no check compares it with the code. A gate on added lines stops new prose from entering without a repository-wide cleanup in one change, and prompts that state the invariant let agents and reviewers catch it before the gate does.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/check_self_explaining.py exits non-zero for a changed Python file that adds a module, class or function docstring, and exits zero for a docstring that already existed on the merge base.

It exits non-zero for an added '#' comment in Python, shell, Makefile, Dockerfile or YAML files, and accepts a '# why:' comment, shebangs, encoding lines, '# noqa', '# type:', '# pragma', '# fmt:' and shellcheck directives.
A '#' inside a string literal is not reported as a comment.
The lint task in pyproject.toml, the staged-files mode of scripts/pre_commit_check.py and the hygiene workflow each run the check.

The four prompt templates state the invariant, and the review loop template tells reviewers to report violations as Important findings; apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_prompt_templates.py asserts these phrases.
uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass, and no existing docstring or comment is removed by this change.
